gui.the_long_travail.catalog.abyss.local: Only active in biomes that allow rain or snow.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.abyss.sky: Only active with open sky overhead.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.abyss.carry: Carrying multiple copies does not stack their effects.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.abyss.eki.i: Carry Eki while wearing The Long Travail to activate it during rain, snow or thunderstorms in the Overworld.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.abyss.eki.m: While wearing The Long Travail with Abyss Malice:
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.abyss.eki.w: While wearing The Long Travail with Abyss Witness:
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.abyss.eki.i: When taking damage, has a %s%% chance to negate it and skip The Long Travail’s received-hit penalties.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.abyss.eki.d: When taking damage, has a %s%% chance to negate it.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.abyss.tokai: While wearing Tokaido during rain, snow or thunderstorms in the Overworld:
Every %s seconds, restore %s hunger and %s saturation
While equipped, press [%s] to summon a rainstorm lasting %s seconds in the Overworld.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.abyss.fluid: Craft Perfect Fluid with a target item to consume one Perfect Fluid and create one copy of that item.
Copies retain durability, enchantments, custom names and stored item data, including container contents.
Stackable targets yield one extra item per craft, not an entire stack
If the target is unstackable or cannot stack with its copy, the original remains in the crafting grid
The Long Travail, Perfect Fluid itself and additionally blocked items cannot be copied.
These items are removed from copied containers and nested containers. Original contents are unaffected.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.abyss.lafit: While wearing Midnight Lafite, newly acquired status effects are adjusted as follows:
Poison duration becomes %s%% of its original duration
Nausea duration becomes %s%% of its original duration
While wearing The Long Travail with Abyss Malice:
Gain a nighttime damage bonus that rises toward midnight, up to %s%%.
When sheltered in non-clear weather, the midnight damage bonus instead reaches %s%%.
While wearing The Long Travail with Abyss Witness:
Become immune to Hunger and Levitation
Gain a %s%% damage bonus at night
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.abyss.abund: While holding Liquefied Abundance, tap right-click to cycle through regular, splash and lingering potions.
Hold right-click for %s seconds to consume one Liquefied Abundance and create a random potion. Each hold converts one item. Release before using it again.
The last held Liquefied Abundance turns directly into the potion
If more remain, the potion enters the inventory or drops if it is full
Lingering potions reduce the duration determined above to one quarter. Instant and infinite-duration effects are unaffected.
If no status effects are available, conversion is canceled without consuming materials.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.glossary.ab:
Uses the world time of the current dimension.
The End always counts as clear weather. The Nether never counts as clear weather.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.glossary.ra: Randomly grants one eligible status effect in the game. Each eligible effect has an equal chance.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.glossary.da:
Increases damage proportionally during damage calculation without changing entity attributes.
Bonuses of this type from this mod add together when active.
gui.the_long_travail.catalog.abyss.abund: If matching potions exist, randomly select an available level, then a duration at that level
Without matching potions, the effect is level I, and non-instant effects last %s seconds
